evals.prompt: Dockerize my Node.js Express app. I also need PostgreSQL and Redis. Give me both dev and production configs. The app runs on port 3000 and uses npm.
evals.expected_output: Multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (dev with hot reload), docker-compose.prod.yml, .dockerignore, with Postgres and Redis services

evals.prompt: I have a Python FastAPI app that needs Docker setup. It uses PostgreSQL for the database and Celery with RabbitMQ for background tasks. Set up both dev and production.
evals.expected_output: Dockerfile with Python slim base, docker-compose with FastAPI, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Celery worker services, dev and prod configs
